request.prompt:
Use your built-in image generation tool to create ONE square 1024x1024 image. The first 4 attached images are STYLE references only (frame, flat shapes, palette); do not copy their birds. The last 1 attached image(s) are references for this bird (earlier icon versions or a photo the art director chose): use them as the art director's change below says. Save the generated PNG into the current working directory as out.png and reply with only its path. This is variation 1; vary the composition a little. Image brief:
Flat geometric bird icon in a Mondrian / De Stijl spirit, matching the reference images. A thick navy square frame (#0B0F24) around an ivory field (#FAF6EE). Right-facing head-and-upper-breast portrait (owls may face straight ahead). The bird is a bold navy silhouette with a few flat color fields; it may run off the bottom and left edges of the frame only, and leaves clear ivory space between the bill tip, crest and the frame. One simple round eye. Use only these colors: navy #0B0F24, ivory #FAF6EE, chrome yellow #F7B902, vermilion #C7301C, Klein blue #002FA7, slate #5E6178. Three or four colors in total. No gradients, shading, texture, outlines of feather detail, scenery, text or labels. Simple shapes that stay readable at 32 pixels.

Species: Eastern Screech-Owl (Megascops asio). Identifying features to show: short triangular ear tufts; compact, nearly square head on a compact body; facial discs rimmed dark at the sides; yellow eyes; small pale bill between the eyes; grey plumage. Proportions measured from a photo: ear tuft height to head height = 0.25. Do not draw: tall ear tufts like a Great Horned Owl; heart-shaped face (that is a barn owl); a long neck.
Art director's change for this version: Face straight ahead, fully symmetric. Eyes: a yellow iris ring around a large black pupil, both eyes exactly the same size, each with a dark brow line over it that gives the stern look of the attached photo. Short ear tufts angled outward, a streaked crown, facial discs rimmed dark, a small pale bill, and a pale breast with dark vertical streaks. Slate-grey plumage.
